sources.quote: Service and aftermarket parts are not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
Service parts are governed by a separate document, STL-CSR-SP-01, which is not part of this excerpt.

findings.why: The request is to ship BR-220 as service parts. The only approval, AP-0311, is for series supply to TO1 for STL, and the approval list states that service and aftermarket parts are outside its scope. No controlled record in the documents covers BR-220 service parts for a receiving plant and customer. Absence of an approval therefore cannot be read as 'not approved', so a person must confirm the service-part source release.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The proposal uses Alluminio B billet already in stock. No certificate or test result for that stock lot is in the documents, and its grade is not stated. The approval and BOM require EN AW-6082-T6. A person must supply the certificate to show the lot is 6082-T6, because the documents cannot confirm it.
